scenes.purpose: Ground the goal in the official desktop preview, highlighting the message input where the goal is entered.
Unfold the goal into the steps MiniMax describes, labeled as product claims rather than measured results.
Close on the exact CTA and URL label.

product-copy.text: Type a goal, select a folder, send.

treatment.continuity: The goal stated in the opening title lands in the screenshot's message input, then branches into four typographic workflow steps on the same white field and blue accent taken from the interface. A short label under the steps marks them as MiniMax's homepage claims, not measured results. Calm mallet bed at 90 BPM throughout; the film settles on the CTA and URL. No image assets on the cards because only one screenshot is supplied and must not be repeated.

treatment.message: A goal entered in the real MiniMax Code screen unfolds into the workflow MiniMax describes: Coding or Work mode, agents teaming up, and work with images, video, audio, scripts and voiceovers. All capabilities are presented as MiniMax's own claims; no measured results are implied.
